title: Storm and the New World
subtitle: We smelled food, we heard thunder, we saw the world of freedom. Everything is cheering for you and me.

items.text: Storm and the New World

items.speaker: Student B
items.text: Did you hear it? Did you hear it?

items.speaker: Student B
items.text: It's the rain! It's raining outside!

items.speaker: Student B
items.text: Climb up the stairs and open the lock ... and then we can get in the watchtower!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Don't let down your guard. Let me see.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: It's an ordinary iron gate. Through that door frame, everything on the first floor of the northwest watchtower is plainly presented.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: In the oval-shaped room, they see a wall phone, a coat rack, and some randomly hunched batons.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: No signs of people on the first floor. Behind the shutters, lightning flashes and thunder rumbles outside.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: ... That's the gunfire for freedom.

items.speaker: “The Ring”
items.text: How are the Shamirs with the lock? Oh! Good for them. The door is unlocked ...!

items.speaker: Isabella
items.text: Shhh ...! Don't get excited now! We haven't gone out yet!

items.speaker: Isabella
items.text: One after another, keep it quiet ...! Don't touch anything.
The kids walk out of the room one after another.
There's tension in the air.

items.speaker: “The Ring”
items.text: The guards should be on the second floor. Let's move!
What stands between them and the outside world is a simple wooden door. There's no lock on it. It can be easily opened with a twist at the door knob.
The round keyhole on the door feels warm.

items.speaker: “The Ring”
items.text: Relax, Vertin. The best is yet to come!

items.speaker: “The Ring”
items.text: Wait till we take a breath of the real air ... Till we stuff ourselves with delicious food ... And till we get back to our country ...

items.speaker: “The Ring”
items.text: There's so much more for us to be shivering at, but in excitement!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: You're right.

items.speaker: Student B
items.text: Let's open it together.

items.speaker: Student C
items.text: Three, two, one ...
Their hands feel warm.

items.speaker: Isabella
items.text: May the freedom be with us!

items.speaker: Student B
items.text: Let's goooo!

items.speaker: Isabella
items.text: Vertin ...! Come outside!!

items.speaker: “The Ring”
items.text: Freedom ...! Long live liberty ...!
They wave at her happily.
There is a gentle push at the back; Vertin finds herself standing outside the door.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Ha ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: The first thing that comes to her senses is a moist, complex smell, coming from various kinds of food.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Then a loud thunder.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Like a celebratory salute ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Meanwhile, people's clothes fall to the ground like confetti.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: At last, a scratchy sound, like something ferrous, falls on the ground.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Vertin.

items.speaker: Z
items.text: Do you want to be ... the Timekeeper?

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Heh, checkmate.
THE END
